characters.name: Rahul
characters.appearance: Anthropomorphic fritter. Round, golden-yellow textured head and body with embedded green chili pieces. Large expressive eyes.
characters.wardrobe: Wears a suit made of the same golden-yellow, chili-flecked fried texture as his skin.
characters.demeanor: Starts happy, becomes sad and insecure, then transforms into confident and successful.

characters.name: Priya
characters.appearance: Anthropomorphic bread roll. Pale beige, soft-looking square head with a rounded top. Large eyes and soft features.
characters.wardrobe: Wears a simple, pale beige outfit draped like a sari or scarf, matching her skin tone.
characters.demeanor: Fickle, easily impressed by status, later regretful.

characters.name: Vikram
characters.appearance: Anthropomorphic bowl of food. Head is a silver bowl filled with spicy red curry, topped with crunchy snacks, onions, and a lemon wedge.
characters.wardrobe: Wears a black button-down shirt, beige trousers, a thick gold chain, and a gold watch.

characters.name: Amit
characters.appearance: Human male, short dark hair, medium build, light brown complexion.

scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: Priya, we make such a great team. Let's always stay together.
Vikram says: Priya? You're still hanging out with Rahul? He can't even speak proper English.
Priya says: He is trying.
Vikram says: Please, he freezes every time he has to speak. He will never be fluent like me.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Shame setup with a relatable Indian-English struggle.
- Names English immediately to set context.
- Establishes the dignity stakes for the protagonist.
